description: Document Library Data is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our document library dataset information contains the information and documents that form our Competitive Markets Document Library. Related Feature Pages Competitive Markets Document Library - Our Competitive Markets Document Library contains various technical documentation, specifications and policies. Glossary of Terms Our Glossary dataset provides definitions for various terms and acronyms found throughout our data. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Open Data Function. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
